name: Fantasy Euthanasia
source:
Reine is an ordinary schoolgirl with extraordinary bad luck, but she always keeps smiling. Then, one rainy night, a mystical stranger named Ruaridh appears with incredible news: she’s the Saviour foretold to defeat the evil Emperor and save his world! 

Naturally, she says yes. Whisked away to the enchanted land of Fantasia, Reine meets a knight, a prince, and a sharp-tongued guardian, each ready to join her quest. It’s all so wonderful, so perfectly like a storybook... 

...almost like she’s heard this story before. 

Will she complete her quest? Will she find love?
Or will she be brutally murdered, alone and friendless, in a world riddled with danger?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4774430/Fantasy_Euthanasia/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
蕾妮是个运气差到极点的普通女学生，脸上却总是挂着笑容。直到某个雨夜，一位名叫鲁阿里的神秘陌生人突然现身，带来了令人难以置信的消息：她正是预言中那位将击败邪恶皇帝、拯救异世界的救世主！

她自然满口答应了下来。被带往魔法国度凡塔西亚后，蕾妮邂逅了一名骑士、一位王子与一名毒舌守护者，三人都随时准备加入她的征途。一切都如此美好，完美得宛如童话绘本……

……简直就像她以前听过这个故事一样。

她能顺利完成使命吗？她能收获爱情吗？
还是会在这个危机四伏的世界里孤立无援地惨遭杀害？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4774430/Fantasy_Euthanasia/]Steam[/url]]
